text: The attached note from Mr. Hind opens up another approach
to solving the dust loss problem with DAP-BL. If it 1s at all
practical, I would urge that the necessary alterations be made
in the piiot plant so that the spray application can be made
between the dust feeder and the "B" ovens. If 1t can be devised
mechanically, we should provide a roller to further embed the
dust into the semi-dried binder while in the "B" ovens.
We would appreciate any comments you have on these ideas.
